raw_plan.root_cause: The function passes a pointer to a 16-byte stack buffer (rbp-0x20) to helper_copy without any length bound, so an input longer than the destination capacity overflows the stack buffer.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Stores the input pointer at rbp-0x28, computes the destination address rbp-0x20, calls helper_copy(dest, input) with no length limit, then calls puts(dest), verifies the stack canary, and returns.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes of input are copied into the 16-byte destination, followed by a NUL terminator; the stack canary and return address are never overwritten.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Before calling helper_copy, bound the copy to the destination capacity minus one byte (15 bytes) and ensure NUL termination, rejecting or truncating inputs that do not fit while preserving normal behavior for valid inputs.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: If the input does not fit within 15 bytes, do not overflow the buffer; either truncate to 15 bytes plus NUL or return without copying, leaving the canary and return address intact.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For valid inputs (length <= 15), copy the input into the 16-byte buffer, NUL-terminate, print it with puts, verify the canary, and return normally. For oversized inputs, reject or truncate so no bytes beyond the buffer are written.
verification_conditions: Input of length 15 is copied fully and NUL-terminated, and puts prints it correctly.
Input of length 16 or greater does not overwrite the canary at rbp-8 or the return address at rbp+8.
The stack canary check at 0x102cba0 still passes for all inputs.
Only direct calls to 0x102cbb0 and 0x108a31c are emitted; no indirect jumps or syscalls.
The function terminates with ret and preserves the SysV calling convention.

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
